integrity: The defining set is derived directly from the coefficient support of the published polynomial. Subcode support is reduced exactly to the intersection of an annihilator with the two-slice defining set plus systematic coordinate columns. Inclusion-exclusion gives the complete subspace counts. A standalone verifier exhaustively checks all subspaces for \(n=3,4,5\) and reproduces the published \(n=3\) ordinary weight distribution.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the specific ternary family \(C'_{D_{F^{(2)}}}\) of Mondal--Lee Theorem 3.9. It classifies subcodes by support size but not by automorphism orbit, and it does not claim analogous formulas for the other LCD families in that article.
title: Complete higher-support distribution of a ternary half-space LCD family
